section.content: Formaldehyde-free aqueous binders containing: A) a polymer consisting of 5 to 100 wt% of an ethylenically unsaturated acid anhydride or an ethylenically unsaturated bicarboxylic acid, the carboxylic acid groups of which can form an anhydride group, and B) an alkanol amine with at least two hydroxyl groups.
不含甲醛的粘结剂，它包括：A)含5-100wt％由烯属不饱和酸酐或其羧基能形成酸酐基团的烯属不饱和二羧酸衍生的单元的聚合物，和B)具有至少两个羟基的链烷醇胺。

The aqueous binders that does not contain formaldehydeThe present invention relates to not contain the aqueous binders of formaldehyde, it comprises:

A) contain 5-100wt% can form by ethylenic unsaturated acid acid anhydride or its carboxyl anhydride group the unitary radical polymerization of ethylenically unsaturated dicarboxylic deutero-polymkeric substance and

B) have the alkanolamine of at least two hydroxyls, wherein aqueous binders comprises the phosphorous reaction promotor that 1.5wt% is following, based on A)+B) total amount.

The invention further relates to binding agent as coating, the purposes of soaker or fibroreticulate binding agent.

Except that the existing binding agent that does not contain formaldehyde, wish to obtain further not containing the binding agent of formaldehyde usually.Because economic reasons wishes that at low temperatures fixed sheet fibrous texture in the extremely short time obtains the favorable mechanical performance simultaneously.Suitable binding agent is safe and in use can discharge toxic substance or environmentally harmful reaction product.And suitable binding agent is made up of easy acquisition, cheap component ideally.

The purpose of this invention is to provide this binding agent.We also find, this purpose can be by above-mentioned binding agent and they as coating, soaker or be used for coating, soaker, and as fibrous reticulum, especially the binding agent of glass fiber mesh is realized.

Equally, can use known redox initiator system as initiators for polymerization.This redox initiator system comprises at least a compound that contains superoxide that merges with the redox aided initiating, reducible sulfur compound for example is as the hydrosulphite of basic metal and ammonium compound, sulphite, thiosulphate, hyposulfite and tetrathionate.For example, can use the merging thing of persulphate and bisulfite basic metal or ammonium salt, for example ammonium persulphate and ammonium bisulfite.The ratio that contains the compound of superoxide and redox aided initiating is 30: 1-0.05: 1 scope.

In order to prepare polymkeric substance, general preferably in the presence of conditioning agent, carry out copolyreaction with low average molecular weight.For this reason, can use common conditioning agent, as organic compound such as 2 mercapto ethanol that contains SH, 2-mercaprol, Thiovanic acid, tert-butyl mercaptan, n-octyl mercaptan, n-dodecyl mercaptan and uncle's lauryl mercaptan; C 1-C 4-aldehyde, as formaldehyde, acetaldehyde, propionic aldehyde; Hydroxyl ammonium salt such as sulfuric acid hydroxylammonium, formic acid, sodium bisulfite or Virahol.Usually, the polyreaction conditioning agent uses with the amount that is equivalent to monomer 0.1-10wt%.Equally, also can influence molecular-weight average by selective solvent.For example, in the presence of the thinner with benzylic hydrogens atom, polyreaction is because chain transfer causes the molecular-weight average that reduces.

50 ℃ down and 72 hours inner dryings obtain the film of 0.3-1mm thickness and subsequently, 15 minutes binding agents of the present invention of curing preferably have more than the 50wt% in air and under 130 ℃, more than the preferred especially 60wt%, more than the more preferred 70wt%, the above gel content of 75wt% especially.

After the curing, under 23 ℃, the solidified film was stored in water 48 hours.Solvend is retained in the water.Subsequently, this film drying under 50 ℃ is constant weight and weighs.Weight is corresponding with gel content, and gel content calculates with wt%, to separate solvend weight before.When the reduction of weight after 3 hours less than 0.5, during especially less than 0.1wt%, obtain constant weight.

Binding agent of the present invention is particularly useful as the fibrous reticulum binding agent.Fibroreticulate example is a Mierocrystalline cellulose, rhodia, cellulose esters and ethers, cotton, hemp, the net of animal fibre such as wool or hair and particularly synthetic or inorganic fibre such as Kevlar, carbon fiber, polyacrylonitrile fibre, trevira, mineral fibre, the net of PVC fiber or glass fibre.

If be used as fibroreticulate binding agent, binding agent of the present invention for example comprises following additive: silicate, siloxanes, boron-containing compound, lubricant, wetting agent.

Glass fiber mesh is preferred.Binding agent of the present invention has agglutinating fibrous reticulum (protofibril net), particularly glass fiber mesh is not changed into effect fixed or the agglutinating net.

For this reason, binding agent of the present invention, for example by coating, dipping, saturation process is applied to that agglutinating is not online, and preferably the weight ratio according to fiber/polymer thing A (solid) is 10: 1-1: 1, preferred especially 6: 1-3: 1.

Binding agent of the present invention is preferably to have the water-based dilution dosage form use that water-content is 95-40wt%.

After binding agent of the present invention is applied on the net,,, most preferably dry preferred 10 seconds-10 minutes time under 130-230 ℃, be in particular 10 seconds-3 minutes time especially at 130-280 ℃ usually preferably at 100-400.

Resulting viscose fibre netting gear has high doing and wet tenacity.After the drying, the agglutinating fibrous reticulum does not show any significant yellowing phenomenon, if any.Binding agent of the present invention provides extremely short time of drying and extremely low drying temperature.

Agglutinating fibrous reticulum, particularly glass fiber mesh can be used as and be used for roof boarding, are used as the loading material of wallpaper or are used as the floor covering for example inner lining material or the loading material of PVC floor covering.The PVC floor covering that uses fixed glass fiber mesh of binding agent of the present invention and PVC plastisol to prepare does not almost have the tendency of jaundice.

When as roof boarding, the agglutinating fibrous reticulum is used bitumen coating usually.

Binding agent of the present invention also can with other binding agent for example, contain the binding agent such as the urea-formaldehyde resins of formaldehyde, melamine-formaldehyde resin or phenol-formaldehyde resin blend are used.

Binding agent of the present invention can further be used as by above-mentioned fiber, particularly inorganic fibre such as mineral fibre and glass fibre, the binding agent of the insulating material of composition.

Up to now, the shortcoming that has based on the common bond of phenol formaldehyde condensation resin is, in the preparation of insulating material, and a large amount of phenol, formaldehyde and its lower molecular weight condensation product volatilize with vapor form.Must adopt the big method of cost to stop them to be discharged in the environment.And, the insulated product release formaldehyde of finishing, this is undesirable especially when insulating material is used for the resident and builds.

The fiber that is used for insulating material in industry widely the spinning of the melt by corresponding raw mineral materials prepare (referring to embodiment E P 567 480).

In the preparation of insulating material, aqueous binders solution is preferably sent forth on the fiber that has just prepared, and takes advantage of fiber when also hot.Most of water volatilization stays with non-substantially solid state and adheres to resin on the fiber, is the highly filled material of viscosity.Then, fiber is used to prepare the fiber mat that contains binding agent.These fiber mats are further carried through suitable travelling belt and are passed through curing oven.Resin solidify to form the heavy-gravity heat-curable matrix under about 150-350 ℃ furnace temperature.After the curing, the insulating material pad is suitably repaired, and promptly is cut into the shape that is suitable for the final user.

Employed binding agent comprises conventional auxiliary agent and additive materials in the preparation insulating material.Its example is a hydrophobizing agent, silicone oil for example, and organoalkoxysilane such as 3-aminopropyltriethoxywerene werene be as couplant, and solvable or emulsifiable oil is as lubricant and dust-proofing agent and wetting aid.

The mineral of employed main ratio or glass fibre are to have diameter in the scope of 0.5-20 μ m and the length scope at 0.5-10cm in insulating material.

The conventional type of service of insulating material is rectangle or triangular piece and volume net.The thickness of insulating material and density change in very wide scope, make to prepare the goods with required insulation effect.Conventional thickness range is 1-20cm, and conventional density is 20-300Kg/m 3Insulation effect is to characterize by thermal conductivity λ (mW/m ° of K).Insulating trip has very high dry strength and wet tenacity.

Binding agent of the present invention also can be used for preparing pot clearer or the scourer based on fibrous reticulum.Fiber can be natural fiber and synthon, particularly mineral fibre or glass fibre.The fibrous reticulum of pot clearer or scourer preferably uses the process of sending forth to solidify.

Determining of molecular-weight average:

Weight-average molecular weight is by gel permeation chromatography (GPC), uses moisture elutriant to measure.System is proofreaded with the sodium polyacrylate mixture of wide distribution, its accumulative total molecular weight distribution curve is measured by the GPC laser light scattering that is coupled, according to people's such as M.J.R.Cantow check and correction method (J.Polym.Sci.[polymer science magazine], A-1,5 (1967), 1391-1394), but do not have the concentration correction of being advised.Employed elutriant is three (methylol) aminomethane (TRIS) aqueous buffer solution (0.08 volumetric molar concentration).Chromatographic column is being adorned TSK PW-XL 3000 and TSK PW-XL 5000 (by TosoHaas) as mutually static.The elementary errors refractometer is used for detecting.

Determining of solids content:

With true quantitative samples weighing (starting weight) in the aluminium dish.Under 50 ℃, with sample in loft drier dry 72 hours.Then, sample is weighed once more (final weight).The percentage ratio of solids content is by following calculating: SC=final weight * 100/ starting weight [%].

Determining of viscosity:

Soltion viscosity is to use the LVF viscosity apparatus of Brookfield to determine.Sample is adjusted to 23 ℃ in advance.

Application test:

Glass fiber mesh

Binder solution A-Q is diluted with water to total solids level to be 15wt% and to introduce in the steeping vat.Employed net is the glass fiber mesh that is of a size of 26.5 * 32.5cm, and it makes pre-bonding slightly with melamine-formaldehyde resin (increases by about 7% binding agent, the about 50g/m of unit weight 2).In steeping fluid, soak after 2 hours 20 seconds, excessive binding agent is sopped up, reaching binder content is 20% (based on gross weight), under the temperature of setting (T) with glass fibre dry preset time (t) (referring to table 2) in Ma Shi (Mathis) stove of dipping.Glass fiber sheets is cut into the wide bar of 50mm, and their speed with 50mm/min on tensile testing machine is stretched to breaking point (doing breaking tenacity BS).The fibrous reticulum temperature provides in table 2.In order to measure wet tenacity, under 25 or 80 ℃, corresponding test bar is placed on reaches 15 minutes in the water, subsequently, under specified temperature, under wet condition, be stretched to fracture (wet breaking strength BS).Measuring result (mean values of five samples) provides with newton (N) and is wide based on the test film of 50mm.

In order to determine cooking loss (BOL), measure and boil the heavy drop-out value of net after 15 minutes in the distilled water.
